_comment: Single source of truth for category names shared by the Go engine and the Laya sidecar. The Go test TestCategoriesMatchSidecar fails if a Go category is missing here. 'assignable' categories may be chosen by Laya for ambiguous debits; the rest are only set by deterministic Go passes.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.description: restaurants, fast food, groceries, market money, bakeries, foodstuff

categories.name: Late Night Food & Lounges
categories.description: food delivery apps, bars, lounges, clubs, nightlife

categories.name: Commute & Transit
categories.description: ride hailing, bus, keke, okada, transport fare, fuel, petrol

categories.name: POS Cashout & Agency
categories.description: POS agents, cash withdrawal through agency banking

categories.name: Tech & Cloud Infrastructure
categories.description: cloud hosting, SaaS, developer tools, software subscriptions for work

categories.name: Workspace & Co-working
categories.description: co-working desks, office internet, workspace rental

categories.name: Airtime & Utilities
categories.description: airtime, mobile data, electricity tokens, DisCo bills

categories.name: Bills & Online Payments
categories.description: payment gateways and bill aggregators such as Remita, Quickteller, CoralPay

categories.name: Subscriptions & TV
categories.description: DSTV, GOtv, Netflix, Spotify, streaming subscriptions

categories.name: Education
categories.description: school fees, tuition, WAEC, JAMB, exam registration

categories.name: Rent & Housing
categories.description: house rent, caution fee, agency fee, waste and water bills

categories.name: Family & Favors
categories.description: one-off transfers to individuals: allowances, upkeep, gifts, urgent favors

categories.name: Religious Giving
categories.description: church tithes, offerings, mosque donations, zakat

categories.name: Betting & Gaming
categories.description: sports betting and gaming platforms

categories.name: Loans & Debt Service
categories.description: loan app repayments and debt service

categories.name: Ajo & Thrift
categories.description: ajo, esusu, adashe, cooperative and thrift contributions

categories.name: Personal Care
categories.description: hair, barbing, makeup, grooming

categories.name: Shopping & Retail
categories.description: online and in-store shopping, clothing, electronics

categories.name: Market & Small Vendors
categories.description: traders, market sellers and small shops paid by transfer, often through personal-name or Moniepoint accounts

categories.name: Commercial & Business
categories.description: payments to businesses and suppliers: ventures, enterprises, stores, limited companies

categories.name: FinTech & Investments
categories.description: savings wallets and investment platforms

categories.name: Bank Fees & Charges
categories.description: EMTL, stamp duty, SMS, USSD, VAT and transfer fees

categories.name: Income & Retainers
categories.description: salary, client payments, retainers

categories.name: Loan Disbursement
categories.description: loan proceeds received

categories.name: Internal Transfers
categories.description: transfers between the holder's own accounts

categories.name: Reversals & Refunds
categories.description: reversal credits for failed debits

categories.name: Black Tax (Family Support)
categories.description: recurring family support detected from payment periodicity

categories.name: Recurring Obligations
categories.description: recurring same-amount payments detected from periodicity

categories.name: Personal Discretionary
categories.description: general lifestyle spending that fits no other category
